<thought>We need a SMILES that matches the given formula C8H9O3N2. A plausible structure is a phenyl ring bearing a carbonyl attached to a di‑nitrogen group and an additional oxygen, e.g., a salicyl‑amide with an extra hydroxyl. The SMILES "O=C(N)Nc1ccccc1O" represents such a molecule and should correspond to C8H9N2O3.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(N)Nc1ccccc1O</final_answer>
